content: सवर्ण {%a.%} [समानो वर्णो यस्य] .²1 Of the same colour. .²2 Of like appearance, like, resembling; दुर्वर्णभित्तिरिह सान्द्रसुधासवर्णा <ls>Śi. 4. 28</ls>; <ls>Me. 18</ls>; <ls>R. 9. 51</ls>. .²3 Of the same caste or tribe; उद्वहेत द्विजो भार्यां सवर्णां लक्षणान्विताम् <ls>Ms. 3. 4</ls>. .²4 Of the same kind, similar. .²5 Belonging to the same class of letters, requiring the same effort (of the organs of speech) in pronunciation; तुल्यास्यप्रयत्नं सवर्णम् <ls>P. I. 1. 9</ls>. .²6 Having the same denominator. .{@-र्णः@} the son of a Brāhmaṇa and a Kṣatriya woman, a Māhiṣya.
